analytics-tracking 1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial release of the analytics-tracking skill.
- Provides best practices and structured frameworks for implementing and auditing web analytics, event tracking, UTM strategy, and conversion measurement.
- Supports guidance for GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM parameters, and popular analytics tools (Mixpanel, Segment, etc.).
- Includes templates for event naming conventions, tracking plans, privacy/compliance requirements, and debugging checklists.
- Designed to help users set up actionable analytics for marketing and product decisions.
